news.title: Suno launches v6, the AI music model licensed by Warner, BMG and Believe
Suno Launches Advanced AI Music Model Amid Legal Challenges
“Suno’s v6 is not a fresh start; it is the fruit of the same poisoned tree”: Universal and Sony sue AI firm over continued copyright infringement in its new model

bullets: Define the video creation experience — Understand how people want to bring their music to life, then turn those insights into a clear product vision and roadmap.
Build from zero to one — Lead the product from early prototypes through launch, making thoughtful choices about creative controls, generative video capabilities, and the path from…
Make video part of Suno — Partner with other product teams to design how creators share their videos and how audiences discover and engage with them across web and mobile.
Shape a sustainable business — Explore how video creates value for creators and Suno, and help develop a business model that can grow with the product.
Launch and grow the product — Define what success looks like, learn from what creators make and where they get stuck, and improve the experience as adoption grows.
